senses.gloss:
(उ) दिवु r. 4th cl. (दीव्यति)
1 To play, to sport, to play with, to romp or gambol.
2 To desire, to overcome, to be ambitious of surpassing, &c.
3 To deal, to traffic, to buy or sell.
4 To shine, to be splendid or beautiful.
5 To praise.
9 To be glad, to rejoice.
7 To be mad, to be wild or inflated with pride, passion, &c.
8 To be sleepy or sluggish.
9 To love, to desire.
10 To go.
r. 10th cl. (देवयति)
1 To suffer pain.
2 To ask, to beseech or beg.
3 To move, to go.
(-ति ते)
To lament, to wail, to mourn audibly.
(इ) दिवि r. 1st cl. (दित्वति)
1 To please.
2 To be pleased.

n. (-वं)
1 Heaven, paradise.
2 Heaven, sky, atmosphere.
3 A day.
4 A wood, a thicket.
E.
दिव to play, to shine, &c. affix कः see the preceding.

ind.
By day, the day.
E.
दिव to play, &c. affix का.

f. (-द्यौः-दिवौ-दिवः)
1 Heaven, paradise.
2 Air, sky.
E.
दिव to play, affix क्विष्, where sport immortals; also दिव.

m. (-वा)
A day.
E.
दिव to play, Uṇādi affix अन्.

mn. (-सः-सं)
A day.
E.
दिव to play, कसच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
दिवस day, and कर who makes.

n. (-खं)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
दिवस day, and मुख beginning.

m. (-यः)
Evening, close of day.
E.
दिवस, and अत्यय loss.

n. (-नं)
Evening, close of day.
E.
दिवस, and अवसान end.

m. (-तिः)
A name of INDRA, the Indian JOVE.
E.
दिवः of day, and पति lord, Divespiter.

f. du. (-व्यौ)
Heaven and earth.
E.
दिव heaven, and पृथिवी earth, स inserted for the sake of euphony.

m. (-रः)
1 The sun.
2 A crow.
3 A flower, the sun-flower.
E.
दिवा the day, and कर who makes.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
1 A man of a low or impure caste, a Caṇḍāla.
2 A barber.
3 An owl.
E.
दिवा by day, and कीर्त्ति credit, (the barber is not allowed to operate at night,) or दिवा day, अकीर्त्ति disrepute; the Caṇḍāla and owl coming abroad only in the dark.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done by day.
E.
दिवा, and कृत done.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going about by day.
E.
दिवा, and चर who or what goes.

m. (-नः)
A crow.
E.
दिवा by day, अट to go, affix ल्यु.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to the day.
E.
दिवा by day, ट्यु aff.

n. (-शं)
Day and night.
E.
दिवा, and निशा night.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Being blind by day.
m. (-न्धः)
An owl.
E.
दिवा by day, and अन्ध dark or blind.

m. (-तः)
1 An owl.
2 A thief or house-breaker.
3 The white lotus, (कुमुदाकर); perhaps any such flower, the petals of which open at night, and close in the day time.
E.
दिवा day, and भीत afraid.

m. (-तिः)
An owl.
E.
दिवा by day, and भीति fear: see the preceding.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
दिवा, and मणि a jewel.

n. (-ध्यं)
Mid-day, noon.
E.
दिवा, and मध्य middle.

n. (-त्रं)
A day and night.
E.
दिवा, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

f. (-त्रिः)
1 Day or night.
2 A day and night.
E.
दिवा, and रात्रि night.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
A sleep by day.
E.
दिवा, and सुप्त asleep.

m. (-विः)
The blue jay.
E.
दिव to play, affix कि.

f. (-वी)
A sort of insect; also उपजिह्विका.
E.
दिव to play, क affix, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-विः)
The blue jay.
E.
see दिवि and किकीदिवि, &c.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Celestial, heavenly, of heavenly origin.
E.
दिवि in heaven, and ज born.

m. (-द्)
A deity.
E.
दिवि in heaven, सद् to go, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Celestial, heavenly, situated in heaven.
E.
दिवि in heaven, and स्थ what stays.

m. (-काः)
1 A deity.
2 A kind of cuckoo, the Chataka: see दिवौकस्.

m. (-सः)
DIVODĀSA, a king so named, king of Benares, and founder of the Indian school of medicine.
E.
दिवः of heaven, दास the slave.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Born or produced in heaven.
f. (-वा)
Cardamoms.
E.
दिव heaven, उद्भव born.

m. (-काः)
1 A deity.
2 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
3 A deer.
4 A bee.
5 An elephant.
E.
दिव heaven, ether, ओकस् a mansion; also with the vowel unaltered दिवोकस्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 Divine, celestial.
2 Beautiful, agreeable, charming.
m. (-व्यः)
1 Barley.
2 A fragrant resin, (Bdellium.)
3 The divine character or property.
f. (-व्या)
Emblic myrobalan.
n. (-व्यं)
1 Cloves.
2 A sort of Sandal.
3 An ordeal.
4 An oath.
E.
द्यु the sky or heaven, and यत् aff.

m. (-री)
One who undergoes an ordeal.
E.
दिव्य, and कारिन् who makes.

m. (-न्धः)
Sulphur.
n. (-न्धं)
Cloves.
f. (-न्धा)
Large cardamoms.
E.
दिव्य, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-नः)
A Gandharba or singer of heaven.
E.
दिव्य divine, and गायन a singer.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षु-क्षुः)
1 Beautiful-eyed.
2 Blind.
m. (-क्षुः)
1 A sort of perfume.
2 A monkey.
n. (-क्षुः)
The faculty of seeing what is invisible by the human eye.
E.
दिव्य divine, and चक्षुस् an eye.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Fit for an offering or oblation.
E.
दिव्य divine, and दोहद wish, that which is the subject of a deity's desires.

mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
Virtuous, agreeable.
E.
दिव्य, and धर्म्मिन् virtuous.

n. (-तं)
A mixture of five articles, ghee, curds, milk, butter, and sugar.
E.
दिव्य divine, पञ्च five, and अमृत ambrosia.

n. (-त्वं)
The fabulous gem Cintāmaṇi.
E.
दिव्य divine, and रत्न jewel.

m. (-थः)
The car or vehicle of any deity.
E.
दिव्य divine, रथ a carriage.

m. (-सः)
Quicksilver.
E.
दिव्य divine, and रस juice.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
1 Clothed or invested in celestial raiment.
2 Handsomely dressed.
m. (-स्त्रः)
A plant, commonly Sūryaśobhā, a sort of sun-flower.
E.
दिव्य divine, वस्त्र cloth or clothes.

f. (-व्या)
The heroine of a poem, as SĪTĀ, &c. of mixed origin or character, a demigoddess.
E.
दिव्य divine, अदिव्य not divine, partaking of both natures.

m. (-घः)
A form of ŚIVA, worshipped by the Tāntrikas.
E.
दिव्य, and ओघ heap.

n. (-कं)
Rain water, dew, &c.
E.
दिव्य heavenly, and उदक water.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Divine, celestial, of heavenly birth or being.
E.
दिव्य divine, पद to go, with उप prefixed, and उकञ् aff.

mfn. (-व्यन्-व्यती-व्यत्)
Playing, sporting.
E.
दिव play, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Throwing, darting, shooting.
2 Playing.
E.
दिव to play, शानच् aff.
